system.description:
The Rogue from the badlands, sits waiting patiently, hunting his prey. He takes a jug of Water from his pouch and begins to drink from is carefully, not wasting a single drop. After finishing, he reaches behind himself and grabs a large Odachi with one hand, as his arm expands showing a massive increase in strength. He leaps from his hiding place bring the blade down on his mark.

—Hato Hyoshi

At Worlds End, Ch. 17 excerpt.

Demons Second coming

The Hozuki Clan is a relatively small clan that hails from the Land of Water. While the clan itself is small, it has had prominent members, whom have attained the rank of 7 Swordsmen and garnered a notoriety of being excellent swordsman and even better assassins. The Hozuki clan has a unique trait, allowing them to turn their body into a liquid form passively. Though due to this extreme affinity with the Water Release affinity, they have lost the ability to access the Lightning Release Affinity, in its entirety.

Hozuki Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str, +1 Int

Speed: 30 feet

Skill Proficiencies: Martial Arts, Chakra Control.

Water Release Affinity: You begin with the Water Release affinity.

Swimming Speed: You have a swimming speed equal to your land speed.

Liquid Biology: You can breathe air and Water.

Altered Water: Earth Release no longer has an elemental advantage to jutsu you cast with the Water release keyword. Lightning Release now has an elemental advantage against jutsu you cast with the water release keyword.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Hozuki Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Hozuki Techniques: The Hozuki Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Hozuki Features

Hydration

1st Level Clan Feature

The Hozuki clan are widely known across Kirigakure as an elite shinobi clan, often in the running for Mizukage and often having members occupy a position on the Seven Swordsmen of the Mist due to its unique Kekkei Genkai, allowing them to liquefy their bodies at will, becoming living water. This can be achieved by expending their bodies natural Hydration. You have a pool of Hydration equal to 1 + your highest ability modifier. You regain spent Hydration when: you complete a long rest, take damage from a jutsu with the Water Release keyword, begin your turn with at least half your body submerged in a body of water, or when you cast a jutsu with the Water release keyword and gain the benefit of a sufficient source of water. Once per turn, when you take lightning damage, you lose 2 Hydration.

You can spend Hydration to fuel your Kekkei Genkai’s Liquification Techniques.

Capillary Infiltration. By spending 2 Hydration on your turn, until the end of the current turn, you can squeeze through opening as small as 1 inch and gain immunity to the Grapple and Restrained conditions as your physical form becomes liquid.

Hydrofication. As part of casting a Hozuki Hijutsu, you can spend 1 Hydration to use the Hijutsu’s Hydrofication effect.

Liquid Evasion. As a reaction to taking bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, cold or earth damage, you can spend 1 Hydration to shift the impacted body part into liquid, gaining resistance to the triggering damage, and slushing away as a puddle, moving up to 10 feet before reforming. This movement doesn’t trigger opportunity attacks. If the triggering damage is cold, you instead gain temporary hit points equal to the triggering jutsu’s rank in place of taking damage (D-Rank: 5, C-Rank: 10, B-Rank: 15, A-Rank: 20, S-Rank: 25).

Liquid Impact. If a hostile creature would score a critical hit against you, you can spend 3 Hydration to turn the critical hit into a normal one.

Water Pistol. By spending 2 Hydration on your turn, for the next minute, you when you take the Attack Action, you can make one Water Bullet attack. This increases to 2 attacks at 7th level and 3 attacks at 15th level. The action taken to use the Water Bullet attack counts as casting a Hozuki Hijutsu, with the Ninjutsu and Water release keywords at the highest rank you can cast.

Water Bullet. Make a ranged jutsu attack against a creature you can see within 30 feet, using your highest jutsu ability modifier. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + ability modifier in bludgeoning, piercing or cold damage. Beginning at 7th level this attack has 6 Pierce. Beginning at 11th level, this attacks damage increases to 2d8. Beginning at 15th level this attack has 12 Pierce.

Water Muscles. When you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage], you can spend 1 Hydration to increase the damage you deal with the chosen damage calculation by +2 until the end of your next turn. This increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th level.

Mistborn Infiltrator

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Hozuki clan excel in infiltration and information gathering through positioning a clever use of the clans liquid body techniques. Select two of the listed Liquid Infiltration techniques that you learn, to aid you to break into places or gather information at a more efficient level than others. You gain an additional selection at 11th level.

Vapor Shroud

As a bonus action, you exhale a thin halo of mist that clings to you for the next minute. While shrouded in this way, yourself an allied creatures that begin their turns within 10 feet of you gain a rank of mastery to Stealth checks and a +10 bonus to your speed. This increases to two ranks at 7th. Suffering the hostile effects of a jutsu with the Wind or Lightning Release keyword ends this effect early. Once this effect is used, you cannot do so again until they complete a short rest.

Hydrophonic Sense

While you are in contact with a source of liquid such as puddles, flooded halls, sewers, you gain tremor sense based on that liquid up to 1 mile away. In addition, conversations had near the body of water can be heard by you. You can only focus on one location at a time and thus cannot perceive all conversations had near a body of water.

Rain Traversal

You leave no tracks or scent when moving through rain, mist or standing water. Creatures attempting to track you through while you are experiencing any of the aforementioned environmental situations, increase the DC to do so by +10.

Mist Voice

You can communicate with creatures that are in contact with the same body of water as you, within 120 feet of you. You can exchange simple messages no longer than 10 words through small bubbles containing your voice, quiet enough to only be heard by the intended creature.

Dampen Reverb

As a bonus action, you can create a 10-foot radius bubble of water, centered on you. This bubble of water lasts for 10 minute or a hostile creature passes through the radius of the bubble. Sound cannot escape the inside of the bubble, nor penetrate to the inside of the bubble. Once used cannot be used again until you complete a short rest.

Follow the Current

7th Level Clan Feature

The Hozuki clans ability to shift their physical forms to and from water, also grants them an immensely unique ability. The ability to infuse themselves with water and traverse it almost instantly.

By spending a Bonus action, while at least half of your body is submerged in a body of water, you can select a space within that body of water no further than 120 feet away and teleport to this space. Once you teleport in this way, you cannot do so again for at least 10 minutes.

Blood As Thick As Oil

11th Level Clan Feature

| #### Mirage Regent / Battle Amp / Your body becomes thin and almost frail as you spread most of the water in your body into a mist of your absolute control. / Mist Mirage. You radiate a cloud of mist, filling a 30-foot radius, centered on you, that moves with you. Hostile creatures treat the affected area as difficult terrain and you are heavily obscured against hostile creatures until said creature is within 10 feet of you. / Where are You Looking?. The first time per turn when a creature attacks you, you can roll a d12. On a roll of 11 or less, their attack misses as it strikes a mirage. Once a creature misses in this way, reduce the roll needed to miss by 1 (10 or less > 9 or less > 8 or less, etc.). / Everywhere and No where. Attacks you make and jutsu you cast can originate from anywhere within your mist. |

The Hozuki clan while wildly recognized for their ability to transform into water, you have found that with a little focus you can shift your body into substance more akin to oil. As a result, Hijutsu you cast with the Water Release keyword now have an elemental advantage against jutsu with the Earth release keyword. In addition, Hijutsu you cast that deals damage, treats structures and constructs with hit points as if the structure and construct is vulnerable to its damage.

Heir of the Mist

15th Level Clan Feature

You have become the pinnacle of what a Hozuki clansmen strives to be. You have reached an apex that others only dare to dream of. But you don’t walk this path alone, you draw inspiration from your forefathers.

First, Once per turn, when you cast a jutsu with the Water Release keyword that costs chakra, you can spend 2 Hydration to gain temporary hit points equal to the rank of the jutsu cast. These temporary hit points last until the beginning of your next turn (D-Rank: 5, C-Rank: 10, B-Rank: 15, A-Rank: 20, S-Rank: 25).

Finally, when you complete a long rest, select one of the following Tidal States, of which you gain their listed effects until you complete your next long rest, after which you can choose to swap or keep your same Tidal State. You can enter your chosen state for 1 minute, by taking a bonus action and spending 4 Hydration. Once you enter a state you cannot reenter it until you complete a rest.

Tidal Gains

You enter your Tidal Gains state, focusing an absurd amount of Water into your muscles causing them to expand and become similar to that of a body building strong man. Once you exist this state you cannot enter it again until you complete a short rest.

Mirage Regent

You enter your Mirage Regent state, allowing you to spread the water your body is formed from into a large are, creating a mist of your design.

| #### Tidal Gains / Battle Amp / You embolden your physical strength to new heights, enlarging your muscles and reinforcing your brutal physique. / Colossus. Your size increases to Lear, melee weapon and unarmed attacks you make gain the Reach 1 Property, if they didn’t already. You make Athletics checks at advantage. / Muscular Overdrive. You gain the benefits of the Water Muscles Liquification techniques for the duration, at no Hydration cost. / Water Canons. Increase Cold damage you deal as a result of casting a jutsu with the Water Release keyword by +1 die. / Hydro Armor. You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing. Slashing, cold and fire damage. / Water Pressure. Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] to a large or smaller creature, you can force them to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain 2 ranks of Weakened and are knocked Prone |
